summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) end-to-end: implement write-enabled file sharing with proper IPNS key management, permission upgrade/downgrade, and recipient write actions in SharedFileBrowser.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 fully completed: 3 plans executed, 5 UAT bugs found and fixed during checkpoint verification, a full security review performed with all 8 findings remediated using TDD, 21 E2E tests written and passing, PR #372 created and all 20 review threads resolved across 3 review rounds.

repo: Writable shares use dual-key IPNS wrapping: owner's public key in FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted, recipient's wrapped copy stored in share_keys with keyType='file-ipns'. Both needed or either party can't update files.

File uploads through shared folders must call createFileMetadata + batchPublishIpnsRecords inline — skipping this (original PoC code set fileMetaIpnsName='') makes uploaded files permanently inaccessible.

withConflictRetry closures capture React state at render time; all four write operations (upload, mkdir, rename, delete) and all navigation functions (navigateToSubfolder, navigateUp, navigateToBreadcrumb) must read from refs (folderChildrenRef, sequenceNumberRef) to avoid stale data bugs.

Owner file updates (useFileOperations.handleUpdateFile) must call reWrapForRecipients after updating file content; without this, recipient share_keys hold the old file key while the file is encrypted with a new key.

TextEditorDialog save path calls updateFile from the owner's useFolder hook — for shared files a separate onSaveSharedFile callback prop is required, wired through SharedFileBrowser from useSharedNavigation.updateSharedFile.

Permission downgrade must delete file-ipns share_keys (or recipients retain IPNS private keys and can continue modifying file metadata after revocation). Wrapped in a manager.transaction for atomicity.

The API client (packages/api-client) must be regenerated after any DTO enum change — OpenAPI spec reflects runtime DTOs, not TypeScript types, so @ApiProperty enum arrays must be kept in sync manually.
IpnsModule importing SharesModule (for findActiveWriteShare) adds SharesService as a dependency of IpnsService, which must be mocked in ipns.service.spec.ts.
Codecov enforces 80% patch coverage and 78% global branch coverage as CI gates.
Dev stack package build order: core → sdk-core → sdk → web. Missing builds cause 'cannot resolve @cipherbox/sdk' errors at Vite startup.
Background bash tasks in Claude Code get killed when conversation context shifts — use nohup/detached process spawning for long-running dev servers.

code.finding: Original PoC set fileMetaIpnsName: '' for shared uploads, making uploaded files inaccessible. Fixed by inlining full IPNS keypair generation and calling batchPublishIpnsRecords.
withConflictRetry in upload handler captured stale React state; all 4 write operations needed to read from folderChildrenRef/sequenceNumberRef instead.

createFolderHandler wrapped subfolder keys with recipient's key (C-02); fix wraps with owner's key in FilePointer and adds separate share_key for recipient. Keys must be zeroed in finally block, not just happy path.
Shared file save path threw 'Parent folder not found' because it called owner-only updateFile. Required new onSaveSharedFile prop and updateSharedFile hook function.
handleUpdateFile did not re-wrap new file key for share recipients after content update. Added reWrapForRecipients call matching post-upload behavior.
createShare lacked permission/IPNS-key invariant validation: write shares without encryptedIpnsKey and read shares with one could be created. Added guard throwing BadRequestException.
Write-share publish authorization checked share.permission === 'write' but not that encryptedIpnsKey is non-null, allowing auth bypass on corrupted share records.
MinLength(2) on encryptedIpnsKey was too low for ECIES ciphertext; changed to MinLength(64). Also lacked even-length hex validation (@Matches(/^([0-9a-f]{2})+$/i)).
Added guard blocking write-share recipients from creating new FolderIpns rows (H-01). Later a too-aggressive version blocked owners from editing recipient-uploaded files and had to be narrowed.

setUpgradingId was set before early-return branches, leaving UI stuck in disabled state if share lookup failed. Fixed with try/finally. Also introduced isBusy(shareId) helper to cross-lock upgrade/downgrade/revoke buttons.

workflow: TDD red-green cycle for security fixes: stash backend agent changes, write failing tests first against unfixed code, verify they fail, pop stash, verify tests now pass.
Security review should be run after implementing crypto features — found 8 issues (2 critical, 3 high, 4 medium, 3 low) that were all worth fixing before merge.
Simplify (code review) pass caught a critical missing ref-sync bug in navigation functions that the security review missed.

E2E tests against real UI require exact CSS class names — must grep the component source; assumptions about class names caused multiple test failures (e.g. .share-recipient-permission vs .recipient-perm-write, modal dialog vs inline input for mkdir).
When background tasks are killed by Claude Code conversation management, check the output file before assuming failure — many appeared as 'killed' but had already committed successfully.
PR review comments marked 'outside of diff range' on GitHub don't appear in normal review thread queries — check the review body directly via gh api repos/.../pulls/.../reviews.
Unused imports after test deletions cause CI lint failures — always clean up imports when removing tests that use specific exception types.

friction: Background tasks killed repeatedly (4+ times) when conversation context shifted — required switching to nohup/detached process spawning, adding significant back-and-forth.
PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring .env recreation from scratch since no .env existed in the CI debug checkout.
Web server failed to start due to unbuilt SDK packages — required discovering and executing the correct build chain (core → sdk-core → sdk) before Vite could resolve imports.
API client regeneration (pnpm api:generate) required after every DTO enum change, and the OpenAPI spec only updates when the API server restarts with the new code — multiple iteration cycles needed.
Git lock file conflict blocked commit mid-session, requiring manual removal of .git/index.lock.
withConflictRetry stale closure bug required multiple passes (security review missed it, simplify agent caught it, then navigation functions were also discovered to be missing the same fix).

IPNS dual-key wrapping required 3 iterations to get right: initial fix (recipient key only) → owner couldn't edit → add owner key in FilePointer → recipient key in share_keys → needed new 'file-ipns' keyType and DTO changes.
CI lint failed post-merge due to unused ForbiddenException import left behind when a test was removed — required an extra commit/push cycle.
'Outside of diff range' review comment on createShare invariant validation was not surfaced in normal review thread queries and required the user to manually point to it.
open_items: Polling endpoint fetches all received shares on every 30s tick (M-04 partial fix) — a targeted single-share endpoint would be more efficient but was deferred as PoC scope.

reWrapForRecipients in handleUpdateFile does not re-wrap file-ipns keys (only file keys) — recipients who uploaded a file will lose update access if the owner edits it and a new IPNS keypair is generated. Noted as design gap, deferred.
E2E tests require page.reload() before Alice sees Bob's uploaded file due to IPNS propagation delay — a proper fix would poll until the IPNS record propagates rather than relying on reload timing.
Pre-existing auth.controller.ts used a local RequestWithUser interface instead of the shared common/types.ts one — partially fixed but device-approval controller has the same pattern.
Pre-existing lint errors in tests/sdk-e2e/src/suites/error-cases.test.ts were not addressed (out of scope for Phase 27).
Writable shares PoC has a 100-received-share polling limit — acceptable for PoC but needs pagination for production.

Security review finding L-02 (BigInt sequence number coercion) was addressed with BigInt() cast but the underlying API returning string vs number inconsistency in sequence numbers was not formally fixed in the schema.
